# Aether UI

> Aether UI is a premium open-code design system for any modern web product — SaaS dashboards,
> marketing sites, and AI-powered applications. Registry format is compatible with shadcn/ui.
> Use the `aether-ui` CLI to install components. All items carry AI metadata.

## Quick Start

```bash
npx aether-ui init                                   # initialise project, creates aether.json
npx aether-ui list                                   # browse available components
npx aether-ui add button                             # install a component
npx aether-ui generate "build me a SaaS dashboard"  # AI-driven scaffolding
npx aether-ui generate "make me a chat interface"   # scaffold AI chat UI
```

## Documentation

- Full docs: https://aether-ui.dev
- Registry API: https://registry.aether-ui.dev/r/registry.json
- AI usage guide: https://aether-ui.dev/llms
- Tokens reference: https://aether-ui.dev/tokens
- Component reference: https://aether-ui.dev/components

## Architecture

Aether UI uses a four-layer architecture:
1. **Primitives** (registry:ui) — foundational components for forms, layout, and interaction
2. **Patterns** (registry:pattern) — higher-level compositions of primitives
3. **Blocks** (registry:block) — full page-section assemblies
4. **Tokens** — design tokens for colors, spacing, typography, and more

AI-native items (registered under `@aether/ai-*`) live in `ai/` subdirectories within each layer
and are SDK-agnostic — they accept plain `string` and `AsyncIterable<string>` props.

## Primitives (51)

## Accordion
- Name: accordion
- Install: aether-ui add accordion
- Source: https://registry.aether-ui.dev/r/accordion.json
- Intent: Collapsible content sections for FAQs, settings panels, or any expandable content
  Slots: AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, AccordionContent
  Often used with: card, separator
  Prompts: add an accordion | create a collapsible section | add an FAQ section

## AI-Native Primitives (14) — @aether/ai-*

All AI primitives are SDK-agnostic. They accept `string` and `AsyncIterable<string>` props;
the consumer wires their own AI SDK (Vercel AI SDK, LangChain.js, OpenAI, etc.).

## Attachment Chip
- Name: ai-attachment-chip
- Install: aether-ui add ai-attachment-chip
- Source: https://registry.aether-ui.dev/r/ai-attachment-chip.json
- Intent: Compact chip showing a file or image attached to the prompt area with remove button
  Slots: filename, size, type, onRemove
  Often used with: prompt-input
  Prompts: add a file attachment chip | show attached file | add an attachment preview

## Chat Bubble
- Name: ai-chat-bubble
- Install: aether-ui add ai-chat-bubble
- Source: https://registry.aether-ui.dev/r/ai-chat-bubble.json
- Intent: User or assistant message bubble with role avatar, timestamp, and trailing actions slot
  Slots: role, content, timestamp, actions
  Often used with: streaming-text, avatar, feedback-buttons
  Prompts: add a chat bubble | add a message bubble | show a user message

## Code Block

- Source: https://registry.aether-ui.dev/r/ai-code-block.json
- Intent: Syntax-highlighted code block with copy button, language badge, and optional filename
  Slots: code, language, filename, showCopy
  Often used with: markdown-renderer
  Prompts: add a code block | display code with syntax highlighting | add a copyable code snippet

- Intent: Slide-in sheet/drawer embedding a ConversationThread + PromptInput for in-app AI assistant
  Slots: open, onClose, systemPrompt
  Often used with: conversation-thread, prompt-input, sheet
  Prompts: add an AI assistant panel | add an in-app chatbot | add a floating AI panel

## AI Onboarding
- Name: ai-onboarding
- Install: aether-ui add ai-onboarding
- Source: https://registry.aether-ui.dev/r/ai-onboarding.json
- Intent: First-time AI feature setup — API key entry, model selection, and example prompts — using Stepper
  Slots: onComplete, models
  Often used with: stepper, model-selector, input, prompt-suggestion
  Prompts: add AI onboarding | add AI setup wizard | add first-time AI configuration

---

## Composition Recipes

### Compose a SaaS Dashboard

```bash
npx aether-ui add dashboard-shell   # full-page layout with sidebar and topbar
npx aether-ui add metric-card       # KPI cards for the overview
npx aether-ui add table-toolbar     # search + filter above data tables
npx aether-ui add table             # data table
npx aether-ui add page-header       # page titles with breadcrumbs
npx aether-ui add empty-state       # zero-data fallbacks
npx aether-ui add loading-state     # async loading indicators
npx aether-ui add error-state       # fetch error fallbacks
```

### Compose an Authentication Flow

```bash
npx aether-ui add login-block       # email + password login
npx aether-ui add signup-block      # registration form
```

### Compose a Marketing Site

```bash
npx aether-ui add marketing-navbar       # top nav with logo and CTA
npx aether-ui add landing-hero           # hero section
npx aether-ui add features-section      # features grid
npx aether-ui add stats-section         # social proof numbers
npx aether-ui add testimonials-section  # customer quotes
npx aether-ui add logo-cloud            # trusted-by logos
npx aether-ui add pricing-section       # pricing tiers
npx aether-ui add pricing-comparison    # feature comparison table
npx aether-ui add faq-section           # FAQ accordion
npx aether-ui add cta-section           # call to action banner
npx aether-ui add footer-section        # site footer
```

### Compose a Full-Page Chat Interface (AI)

```bash
npx aether-ui add ai-chat-layout        # full-page layout shell
npx aether-ui add ai-chat-sidebar       # conversation history sidebar
npx aether-ui add ai-conversation-thread # scrollable message list
npx aether-ui add ai-prompt-input       # input with send button
npx aether-ui add ai-streaming-text     # token-by-token output
npx aether-ui add ai-thinking-indicator # generating animation
npx aether-ui add ai-conversation-starter # empty state with suggestions
```

### Compose an In-App AI Assistant Panel

```bash
npx aether-ui add ai-assistant-panel    # slide-in sheet with full chat
```

### Compose an Agent Workspace

```bash
npx aether-ui add ai-agent-workspace    # task + tool call log + output
npx aether-ui add ai-tool-call-sequence # ordered step list
npx aether-ui add ai-tool-call-card     # individual tool call detail
```

### Compose a Settings Page

```bash
npx aether-ui add section-header        # section labels
npx aether-ui add form-field            # validated form controls
npx aether-ui add input                 # text fields
npx aether-ui add switch                # toggles
npx aether-ui add button               # save/cancel
npx aether-ui add account-settings     # full account settings block
npx aether-ui add team-settings        # team member management
```

---

## Token-Driven Styling

All components consume CSS custom properties from `@aetherstack/tokens`.
Override the design system by redefining tokens in your global CSS:

```css
:root {
  --color-primary: 220 90% 56%;
  --radius: 0.5rem;
}
```
